---

## Y0: Database Schema

**Scope:** All database entities for SRT. The H2 in-memory database contains a single table: `requests`. Schema is auto-generated by Hibernate on startup (`ddl-auto=create-drop`) — the DDL below is the logical equivalent of what Hibernate generates.

---

### Schema: `requests`

**Entity:** `Request` (Java class in backend)  
**JPA Repository:** `RequestRepository extends JpaRepository<Request, Long>`  
**Lifecycle:** Created on Spring Boot startup; dropped on shutdown. All data is lost on restart.

#### DDL (H2-compatible)

```sql
CREATE TABLE requests (
    id          BIGINT          GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    name        VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL,
    title       VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL,
    description CLOB            NOT NULL,
    created_at  TIMESTAMP       NOT NULL
);
```

#### Column Definitions

| Column | Java Field | Java Type | SQL Type | Constraints | Notes |
|--------|-----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-------|
| `id` | `id` | `Long` | `BIGINT` | PRIMARY KEY, AUTO-INCREMENT | Auto-generated; never set by client |
| `name` | `name` | `String` | `VARCHAR(255)` | NOT NULL | Submitter's name |
| `title` | `title` | `String` | `VARCHAR(255)` | NOT NULL | Short title of the request |
| `description` | `description` | `String` | `CLOB` | NOT NULL | Full description text (unbounded length) |
| `created_at` | `createdAt` | `LocalDateTime` | `TIMESTAMP` | NOT NULL | Set by `@PrePersist`; never set by client |

#### JPA Annotations on `Request.java`

```java
@Entity
@Table(name = "requests")
public class Request {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    private Long id;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String name;

    @Column(nullable = false)
    private String title;

    @Column(columnDefinition = "TEXT", nullable = false)
    private String description;

    @Column(name = "created_at", nullable = false, updatable = false)
    private LocalDateTime createdAt;

    @PrePersist
    protected void onCreate() {
        this.createdAt = LocalDateTime.now();
    }

    // Getters, setters (or Lombok @Data / @Getter @Setter)
}
```

---

### Index Strategy

No explicit indexes required for MVP. H2 auto-indexes the primary key (`id`). No foreign keys or join tables exist.

---

### Data Lifecycle

| Event | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| Application startup | `requests` table created empty |
| `POST /api/requests` | One row inserted |
| `GET /api/requests` | All rows read (no modification) |
| Application shutdown | `requests` table dropped; all data lost |
| Application restart | Table re-created empty (fresh start) |

---

### Notes

- H2 stores `CLOB` (Character Large Object) for the `description` field to accommodate potentially long text. In practice for this demo, `VARCHAR(2000)` would also work — `TEXT`/`CLOB` is preferred for correctness.
- The `created_at` column uses `TIMESTAMP` (without time zone). UTC is assumed at the application level. No timezone conversion is performed in this demo.
- There is only one table. No schema migrations, no Flyway/Liquibase.
